what: Chapter 22 of the introduction, "Sealed on BNB Chain, checked by anyone", as a 5 s loop for the chapter panes: the beat at the site's rest, drawn without its caption, scope line or plates, the camera drifting round its rest pose and back. Positions are schematic, as in the story.
name: Sealed on BNB Chain, checked by anyone

code.world: packages/world as the commit holds it

render.command: packages/world: sh scripts/serve.sh <port>; site: WORLD_BROWSER_LIB=<launcher> node scripts/render-chapters.mjs --port <port> --loops witness --seconds 5 --fps 30
render.page: src/story/story.html?mode=capture&cut=master&w=1920&h=1080&captions=none, the player set to the site's stops
render.drawn: 1920 x 1080 CSS px at 1x, Lanczos to each size
